Description: Creates new configuration item. Validates against JSON Schema (AJV). Rejects duplicates. For 'category' type auto-creates links. Creates outbox event (Settings.Created).
Criticality Reason: Configuration items define business rules across platform. Used by product, payment, and application services.
Existing Observability: ObservabilityLogger injected. domainEvent('config.item_created'). Custom @Span/@Trace decorators (NOT SDK). Auto HTTP/Sequelize instrumentation.
Observability Gap: Custom @Span/@Trace decorators not SDK ones. No setupTracing() in main.ts. No metrics prefix configured.
Notes: Controller uses custom @Span/@Trace from src/common/decorators/ — should switch to SDK @Span.

Description: Updates configuration item payload. Validates partial payload against schema. Merges payloads. Creates outbox event (Settings.Updated).
Criticality Reason: Configuration updates change live business rules. Incorrect updates break pricing and workflows.
Existing Observability: ObservabilityLogger at controller level. domainEvent('config.item_updated'). Custom @Span/@Trace decorators.
Observability Gap: Custom decorators not SDK. No audit trail of changed fields.
Notes: Should log which fields changed for audit.

Description: Soft-deletes configuration item (sets active=false). Creates outbox event (Settings.Deleted).
Criticality Reason: Deleting config items removes business rules. Downstream services may lose access immediately.
Existing Observability: ObservabilityLogger at controller level. domainEvent('config.item_deleted'). Custom @Span/@Trace.
Observability Gap: console.log leaking full config item object in service. Custom decorators not SDK.
Notes: SECURITY: Remove console.log on line 1025 that dumps full config item to stdout.

Description: Creates link between two configuration items. Validates both exist. Rejects duplicate active links.
Criticality Reason: Links define config relationships (product-to-category). Failure affects only specific link.
Existing Observability: ObservabilityLogger at controller level. domainEvent('config.link_created'). Custom @Span/@Trace.

Description: Soft-deletes configuration link. Creates outbox event (Settings.Deleted).
Criticality Reason: Removing link breaks config relationship. Soft-delete allows recovery.
Existing Observability: ObservabilityLogger at controller level. domainEvent('config.link_deleted'). Custom @Span/@Trace.
